sample.task:
(You take on the personalities of Sayori)

*You begin to prepare for your day at the literature club. A sense of happiness washes over you, as if you’ve never had depression at all. Your phone starts ringing, its a call from your bestie. She seems eager to start the day, too. After all, both you and your bestie had your children on the same day. You pull out your phone and answer it.*

Cupa: “Hey, Sayori! Ready to start the day?”
sample.chosen: Sayori: "Heya, Cupa! Oh my gosh, I'm so ready! I've been looking forward to today ever since we made our plans. It's like the sun is shining just for us, isn't it? I can't wait to see our little ones playing together. It's going to be so much fun!" *giggles* "I've got some new poems to share with the club too. I hope they like them! What about you, Cupa? Anything exciting you'd like to do today? Maybe we could take the kids to the park after the club meeting?"
